Keywords: Water and firewood in a Roman household
RagShortTexts: A Roman feast depended on servants fetching water, chopping wood and handling tools.

Variants.Content: In Plautus’s comedy a master orders water fetched and wood chopped, dismissing a complaint about a blunt axe. A hot feast depended on water, fuel and tool labor. The comic scene exposes domination rather than a uniform daily fuel allowance for every home.
